messages:
Ava (Design): quick note after yesterday's playtest — the invoke preview panel in the playground looks cleaner but keyboard flow is borked. focus lands on Close and you can't arrow into the tools list. Mateo (DevEx): thanks. that was an intentional focus-lock to avoid accidental background interactions while editing. can you paste steps to repro? Ava (Design): steps: open a function -> click Preview invocation -> hit Tab. focus goes to Close then cycles. expected: Tab should move into the panel body and allow arrow navigation of tool items. Priya (Frontend): yep i can see that. we're using focus-lock with initialFocus set to closeBtn. quick fix idea: set initialFocus to the tool-list container and implement a roving tabindex on items. Raj (Accessibility): roving tabindex + aria-activedescendant sounds good. also add role=listbox on the list and role=option on items. include an sr-only keyboard hint. example snippet: ```html
  • Summarize
  • Call API

Use Tab to enter the list, arrows to navigate, Enter to select.

``` Raj (Accessibility): ensure pressing Esc closes dialog and that opening announces via aria-live/role=dialog. Sam (PM): small product constraint — keep preview lightweight. if initial focus opens the keyboard on mobile and hides content, prefer bottom-sheet behavior on small viewports. Priya (Frontend): agree. plan: desktop = side panel with roving focus; mobile = bottom sheet that doesn't autofocus input to avoid keyboard pop. Mateo (DevEx): proposed rollout: (1) change initial focus to tool-list (small PR), (2) add aria attributes + sr-only hint (Priya), (3) QA keyboard pass (QA-Bot), (4) ship behind feature flag. QA-Bot: added e2e cases: PLG-KEY-37 (panel focus trap), PLG-KEY-38 (roving list keyboard). Ava (Design): copy suggestion — current header "Preview invocation" could show a compact hint. idea: "Invocation preview — Tab / ↑↓ to navigate". Maybe show full instruction only to screen readers. Sam (PM): prefer short visible hint + sr-only full instruction. add a tiny info icon that reveals the hint on hover/focus. Raj (Accessibility): good. ensure info icon is keyboardable and associated with aria-describedby linking to the sr-only text. SR should get the full sentence. Priya (Frontend): i'll add the icon with aria-controls/aria-expanded toggles. will also include Storybook stories demonstrating keyboard flows. Ava (Design): tiny UI nit unrelated: run-history items truncate function names mid-word. can we prefer truncation at word boundary or show ellipsis with full name tooltip? Priya (Frontend): will switch to text-overflow: ellipsis and show full name on hover + compact detail panel for full metadata. Mateo (DevEx): PR queued: github.com/redwood-inference/playground/pull/482-invoke-focus-fixes — assigning @Priya @Raj for review. aiming to merge by EOD and run A11y lab tomorrow. Raj (Accessibility): checklist for PR description: focus order, aria roles, escape behavior, screen reader announcement, mobile behavior. i'll verify after PR lands. QA-Bot: automated regression scheduled; results to be posted in #devex in ~2 hours. Ava (Design): thanks all — appreciate the quick cycle. ping me for micro-copy tweaks if needed. :sparkles:
